svg.title: MAI state sequence
svg.desc: Five states of one Moving Analog Indicator on a shared scale. The PV pointer keeps the same shape and color in every state; abnormality is announced only by a separate Method 3 element (shape + digit) beside the track. Bad quality hatches the track and freezes a hollow outline.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One Indicator, Five States — the Pointer Never Changes

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ANSI/ISA-101.01-2015 · Hollifield HPHMI: abnormality is added beside the value, never painted onto it
